source.verse_hash_method: SHA-256 of the exact original XML verse substring, including written/read notes, not a normalized substitute.
source.public_versification_note: Public and Hebrew numbering align throughout Numbers 11–12. All 51 exact original records are hashed, including the written/read annotation at 12:3 and the source form annotation at 12:9. Later book numbering differences require separate mapping.

key_decisions.decision: Retain the ears and burning images, divine agency and destructive fire; take evil as the evaluation of the complaint, with alternative hardship reading noted.
Keep the narrator’s disparaging group term without assigning an ethnicity absent from the Hebrew; retain strong craving, Israel’s participation and renewed weeping.
Preserve the dried-up self image and eyes fixation; do not turn nefesh into a disembodied soul or add a medical diagnosis.
Retain both distinct comparisons and the ancient material name, with uncertain identification explained selectively.
Keep gathering, alternative grinding/pounding, cooking and cakes; render the difficult oil comparison conservatively and note other understandings without importing honey from Exodus.
Preserve households, tent entrances and intense divine anger; render evil in Moses’ eyes as distress without asserting whether he objects chiefly to the people or the situation.
Keep Moses’ direct accusation, servant/favor relationship and the whole-people burden image without softening his complaint.
Retain both maternal images spoken by Moses and the masculine caregiver image, chest, nursing child and sworn land; do not flatten the mixed imagery into management language.
Keep the emphatic request for God to kill him, conditional favor and first-person misery as pinned; no euphemism, psychological diagnosis or unmarked scribal reconstruction.
Keep divine descent, speech to Moses, partitive spirit transfer and the repeated carrying/alone language; no claim that Moses loses power or that spirit is a material quantity.
Preserve consecration, tomorrow, both quoted complaints and repeated promised eating within the nested speech.
Keep the bodily nostril image, revulsion, rejected divine presence and quoted question; do not soften to merely tiring of meat.
Keep the divine hand image and open rhetorical challenge, with its meaning explained in vocabulary rather than replacing the image.
Resolve the singular speech recipient correctly as Moses, retain spirit transfer and seventy, and follow did not add as not again; note the alternative did not cease tradition.
Keep names, registered status, failure to go to the tent and prophecy in camp; do not silently alter seventy to seventy-two or decide how the two are counted.
Keep Joshua’s name, father and subordinate role; take the difficult qualification as since youth with choice-men alternative noted, and retain the forceful demand.
Preserve jealousy question, universal wish and divine giving of spirit; do not turn the wish into a prediction or restrict the people to men.
Keep wind from the LORD, sea, surrounding extent and two-cubit elevation; preserve the height/depth ambiguity rather than assert a particular landing or flight mechanism.
Retain all three gathering periods, minimum ten homers and spreading; do not confuse homer with omer or assert drying as the only purpose.
Preserve the teeth image and divine responsibility for the severe plague; choose chewed for cut off with consumed/exhausted alternative noted.
